validation_design: 400 dermoscopic images with expert masks, disjoint from the 300 images used to select the configuration.
caveats: Masks are dermoscopic HAM10000; the deployed classifier trains on clinical photographs. The rollout comes from the frozen trunk, which is shared, so this measures backbone attention, not classifier accuracy.
Attention rollout is not causal attribution. High attention does not establish that a region drove the prediction.
Pointing Game's random baseline equals mean lesion area, so it is only meaningful read against that number.

display_normalisation.note: web/lib/model.js normalises the rollout before drawing it. The old p99 upper clip was added to tame the artifact spikes of the max-fusion rollout; with those gone it only flattens the top into a tie and costs pointing accuracy. Measured on 150 held-out masked images.
display_normalisation.adopted: p50 floor, true max ceiling, gamma 1.0
display_normalisation.focus_ratio_warning: The p50 floor inflates focus ratio from ~1.22 to ~2.07 by zeroing the bottom half of the map. Any focus-ratio figure measured after display normalisation is inflated; this is a second way that metric misled.

onnx_parity.comparison: old deployed int8 vs new int8, 40 held-out test images
onnx_parity.verdict: classification path bit-identical; only the rollout branch changed
